lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to write on one stick for Judah, another for Joseph, and join them into one.
God will put the stick of Joseph with the stick of Judah, and they will become one in His heart.
God will gather the Israelites from the nations into their own land and make them one nation under one king.
God's servant Saul will be king over them, and they will live in the land God gave Jacob.
God will make an everlasting covenant of peace and set His sanctuary among them forever, so the nations will know.
